BiblicalUsage: Christ will come to be glorified in His saints in 2 Thessalonians 1:10, and the name of the Lord Jesus is glorified in us in 2 Thessalonians 1:12 — His glory shown in the very people the world despised.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day is coming when Jesus will be glorified in ordinary believers like me, and that hope makes today's small faithfulness worth everything.
